basic_info.description: Your perfect chic & urban retreat in San Francisco! Cubix SF offers a modern living experience with polished concrete floors, radiant heat, stainless steel appliances and exposed concrete walls. Residence 403 is a bright corner unit facing the quiet rear side of the building, boasting abundant natural light.  Enjoy a shared outdoor balcony & a spacious storage unit. Building amenities include a stunning rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of San Francisco downtown, multiple covered cabanas & a BBQ - ideal for entertaining & unwinding, and bike storage. Prime location with convenience to transit. Only steps away from Whole Foods & Yerba Buena Garden, Union Square and countless eateries. Walk Score: 96 | Transit Score: 100 | Bike Score: 87.
